errors.evidence: The description includes the context that the data is from 'in Bulgaria according to an empirical study', which is not mentioned anywhere in the figure itself. This information is inferred from external context (the paper title) and should not be part of a direct figure description.

The description uses the word 'preferred' (предпочитаните) to describe the pricing strategies. The chart only shows the distribution or share of strategies being used, not whether they are 'preferred' over others.
